description: I want to build a stable career in healthcare with better job opportunities and long-term growth. I need a training program that is affordable, flexible, and can fit around my work and family responsibilities. I am concerned about the cost, program length, and whether I will be able to find a job after graduation. I need clear information about tuition, financial aid options, class schedules, and career support to feel confident about enrolling.
